stem.text: A student was provided with two test-tubes, one containing $10\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of solution P and one containing $10\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of solution Q. When these solutions were mixed together and left for 24 hours, the concentration of P decreased but the concentration of Q remained the same.
The student wrote the following conclusions.

items: P may break down over time.
Q may be a biological catalyst.
P may be the substrate for Q.

stem.text: Which conclusions could be supported by the information?
